label: Ordo Exsequiarum — Statio tertia : ad sepulcrum

chants.notes: Antiphon I, sung with Psalmus 4 (verses continue onto p. 704).

Antiphon II, sung with Psalmus 26 (verses run to the end of the book, p. 704). Resolves to gregobase 1870, labelled "(Holy Saturday)" there; a musically identical setting, gregobase 1925 ("Office of the Dead"), exists in a separate un-collapsed chant_group. 1870 is the curated, human-reviewed gr_index_entry pick and has been confirmed as the same antiphon — do not change the match.
